bear.point: CVL profit fell 12% to INR23.74 crores, dragging consolidated earnings despite revenue growth.
Analysts questioned if e-voting adoption declined YoY, indicating potential market share loss.
Government CKYC data improvements threaten pricing power in the KYC registration business.
Competitive intensity in the KYC segment pressures future revenue growth and margins.

bull.point: Revenue grew 23.5% YoY to INR358.70 crores, demonstrating strong top-line expansion.
EBITDA margin expanded 1.1 pp to 63.5%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
18.59 crore demat accounts with 80% market share secure dominant market position.
Debt/equity of 0.00 ensures a pristine balance sheet with zero leverage risk.
